mapper.select: SELECT d.*, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `t_doc_attachment` t WHERE t.`doc_type` = 'send' AND t.`doc_id` = d.`id` AND t.`del_flag` = 0) AS attachmentCount FROM `t_doc_send` d WHERE ORDER BY d.`create_time` DESC

SELECT MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(d.`doc_no`, CHAR_LENGTH(#{prefix}) + 1) AS UNSIGNED)) FROM `t_doc_send` d WHERE d.`doc_no` LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%') AND CHAR_LENGTH(d.`doc_no`) = CHAR_LENGTH(#{prefix}) + 4
